newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Five dead in fresh Albanian violence.
newsitem.headline: Five dead in fresh Albanian violence.

text.p: Five men were killed in a street battle between rival gangs and a house was sprayed with bullets in the latest violence to hit Albania, the state-run news agency ATA said on Saturday.
The Balkan state was thrown into anarchy during riots in February and March as people took to the streets after losing their life savings in pyramid investment schemes.
Although the country is now much calmer, the easy availability of weapons looted in the troubles and an apparent lack of state control in some regions has been fuelling continued violence.
ATA quoted police sources as saying that five people were killed and another was injured late on Friday in the southern town of Elbasan as armed gangs fought in the streets.
On the same day, gunmen unleashed a hail of bullets at a house in the town of Berati, but no one was injured. Local residents said it was a revenge attack although the reason was not clear.
